cross_cutting_semantics.boundedness: A retained batch has at most 64 rows and at most 65536 measured SQL-value payload bytes. A single oversized legal row is executed separately, and the original per-file outcome allocation remains outside this batching bound. No whole-process memory or stable-tail claim is inferred.
cross_cutting_semantics.correctness_vs_performance: The source exposes a plausible reduction of per-row SQL work and adds an actual SQLite StatementStatus::Run comparison. No speedup, latency distribution, stable tail, causal benefit, or resource bound is accepted without original execution evidence.
cross_cutting_semantics.foreign_keys_and_order: The reviewed schema's affected leaf FK edges point to file parents already written by the original file loop, and parent_symbol_id is not a new within-batch FK. Windows cannot admit a later file early. The new future-file FK case exercises the same early-failure boundary. No FK policy is installed by the new seam.
cross_cutting_semantics.fts_and_identity: The original schema keeps symbol_id primary-key and symbol_uid UNIQUE constraints and existing symbol FTS triggers. The new path reuses the same inserts and keeps identity validation after that file's symbols and before the next file. No pending rows cross that check. Conflict/rowid/MATCH test code addresses observable FTS effects instead of checking only a content-table count.
cross_cutting_semantics.parameter_and_payload_identity: All six new payload expression lists exactly match their unchanged existing bind_row lists. At the 64-row tier the column counts imply respectively 1600, 1152, 1920, 640, 704 and 1216 bound parameters; the existing tier/SQL generator remains unchanged.
cross_cutting_semantics.transactions_and_failure: The helper propagates ToSql/prepare/bind/execute errors through existing CcResult/? boundaries. Existing outer transactions, temp-database publication, cleanup and adapter PRAGMAs are untouched. WAL rollback and subsequent successful writes are represented in the new test code. This review does not assert stronger journal-OFF physical rollback guarantees.
cross_cutting_semantics.validation_preservation: All 138 listed validation inputs and the entire P-vs-a23 changed-path set were independently checked. No G2 workflow, 50-method checklist, guard relaxation, protocol budget relaxation, or task-status change is included in P.
